demo.title: Try the radio
demo.intro: These are short samples taken from the product. Start any of them: switching samples automatically stops the previous one.
demo.note: The demos are presentation excerpts. The complete package cannot be downloaded from this page.

position.title: Fight for position
position.transcript: Spanish audio: «El coche de delante lucha por posición, no te rajes». Translation: “The car ahead is fighting for position — don't back down.”

won.title: Victory
won.transcript: Spanish audio: «Vamos, campeón, has ganado. Te voy a dar dos medallas: una por tonto y otra por si la pierdes. Es broma, te quiero, pecador. Buen trabajo». Translation: “Come on, champ, you've won. I'll give you two medals: one for being a fool and another in case you lose it. Just kidding, I love you, sinner. Good job.”

top10.title: Running in the Top 10
top10.transcript: Spanish audio: «No hagas el canelo, vas Top 10, pedazo de tróspido». Translation: “Don't mess about, you're in the Top 10, you daft fool.”

smoking.title: Car smoking
smoking.transcript: Spanish audio: «Quietor, humo como para hacer un café, cobarde. A boxes antes de que tu coche se nos haga churrascos de la pradera». Translation: “Hold it! Enough smoke to make coffee, coward. Get into the pits before your car turns into a prairie barbecue.”

repair.title: Heavy damage
repair.transcript: Spanish audio: «Bro, vas dejando piezas por la pista como migas de pan. Entra en boxes antes de que tengamos que recogerte con pala». Translation: “Bro, you're leaving parts around the track like breadcrumbs. Pit before we have to pick you up with a shovel.”

mostRepair.title: Partial repair
mostRepair.transcript: Spanish audio: «Podemos reparar la mayoría del daño, pero no somos los Reyes Magos». Translation: “We can repair most of the damage, but we're not the Three Wise Men.”
